lesson.title: Who is on the other end?
lesson.goal: The uplink to Edge is shut. Bring it up and use show lldp neighbors to name the device on it.

step.text: On Closet, run show lldp neighbors. The uplink to Edge is shut, so nothing is listed.
Enter interface FastEthernet0/1 and run no shutdown.
Run show lldp neighbors again; Edge appears with its port and a router capability code.
